festivals.label: Elk Grove Lunar New Year Tết 2027

sections.core: Vendors, parking, and carnival cover most of Core ({preSponsor} of {coreTarget}). Sponsor a Core gift below to finish opening the festival — each unlocks stories for social posting.
sections.registry: After Core, choose High Priority gifts that shape what families experience — Saturday stage stories, family moments both days, and the Weather / Cancel Fund. Electives are optional add-ons; funded items run, and the rest wait.
sections.registryPriority: Family linger and Saturday stage stories — sponsor-funded experiences for the weekend. An item runs when it is funded.
sections.registryElective: Optional stories — stage performances, creator meet & greets, Relay Cup, beer garden, elders, décor accents, and more. Funded items run; unfunded ones wait.
sections.tiers: Recognition levels based on your total sponsorship. Tier benefits stack with any registry stories you fund — your build highlights the tier you reach.
sections.options: Sponsor booth spot unlocks at Bronze ($3,000+). Bring your own tent, or add Premium Tent Rental. Premium Tent Rental requires sponsor booth spot.
